Categories.value: Maps of Tamil Nadu|Self-published work|Large images|Geography of Coimbatore district|Anaikatti

ImageDescription.value: Anaikatti is a small village located at the southern end of Attappadi plateau near Coimbatore. Vidyavanam is a tribal school located in this village. This image depicts the streams flowing in the region in 3 dimension.
